==Usage instructions==
Add <nowiki>{{Spoiler|SPOILER INFO}}</nowiki> to an article page that contains spoilers of ''A Memory of Light''.
<pre><nowiki>
{{Spoiler|SPOILER INFO}}
</nowiki></pre>
At SPOILER INFO write what is supposed to be hidden.
==Example==
<pre><nowiki>
{{Spoiler|Rand and the Dark one call a truce and dance off into the sunset.}}
</nowiki></pre>
Looks like:
{{Spoiler|Rand and the Dark one call a truce and dance off into the sunset.}}
[[Category:Administrative templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]
</noinclude>
